name: homemend-worker
description: Cloudflare Workers deployment of the HomeMend MCP server (D1 persistence, static Alexa+ simulator).

scripts.build:assets: pnpm -C ../server build:ui && pnpm -C ../sim build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../sim/dist public/sim
scripts.dev: pnpm build:assets && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8788
scripts.deploy: pnpm build:assets && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
